branches.title: Technical Systems
branches.scope: Mathematics, inference, computation, physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, manufacturing, measurement, operations, safety, reliability and security.
branches.deletion_failure: The learner cannot independently model, measure, build, operate or audit physical and technical systems.

branches.title: Philosophy & Judgment
branches.scope: Methods, logic, knowledge, reality, mind, action, language, value, politics, law, science, technology, world traditions and transformative frameworks.
branches.deletion_failure: The learner can execute but cannot reliably distinguish conceptual, empirical, logical and normative disputes or justify beliefs and values.

branches.title: Human Worlds
branches.scope: Evidence, interaction, strategy, networks, collective action, organizations, power, markets, finance, states, law, politics, inequality, demography, culture, development, world economy, conflict and historical change.
branches.deletion_failure: The learner treats people and institutions as noise around technical systems and cannot reason about incentives, power, coordination or institutional change.

branches.title: Expression & Interpretation
branches.scope: Grammar, diction, rhetoric, argument, narrative, literature, interpretation, speech, style and revision.
branches.deletion_failure: Thought cannot be reliably externalized, transformed for audience and medium, interpreted from difficult works or defended in language.

branches.title: Mind, Learning & Agency
branches.scope: Attention, memory, practice, mental models, expertise, metacognition, motivation, emotion, embodied skill, creativity, social learning, development, judgment and human-AI cognition.
branches.deletion_failure: The architecture lacks an operational theory of how humans acquire, retain, transfer, regulate and renew competence.

branches.title: Design & Representation
branches.scope: Perception, form, diagrams, visualization, typography, spatial design, objects, interfaces, multimodal composition, aesthetics, prototyping, critique and curation.
branches.deletion_failure: Visual-spatial, interface and aesthetic-functional failures recur even when technical and verbal competence remain intact.
